system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 42. 2 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (26 seconds, code score 0.88) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (gentle, reassuring): "Juliana."
[b01] BLOND NOBLEMAN (furious, hysterical): "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"
[b02] ROYAL GUARD (stoic, defiant): "We will not."
[b03] BLOND NOBLEMAN (screaming, outraged): "I said arrest him!"
[b04] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate, unhinged): "Why?!"
[b05] ROYAL GUARD (firm, reverent): "Because we know who he is."
[b06] CATHERINE (trembling, apprehensive): "Rupert..."
[b07] BLOND NOBLEMAN (denial, shaken): "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
[b08] ALEXANDER (cold, commanding): "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
[b09] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (choked with tears): "Alexander..."

--- WINDOW 1 (23 seconds, code score 0.82) ---
[b00] ACTION: His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.
[b01] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (overcome, loving): "Look at you... my beautiful boy."
[b02] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (tearful, proud): "I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be."
[b03] ALEXANDER (tender, resolute): "I have come home, Mother."
[b04] ACTION: Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.
[b05] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (ringing, authoritative): "Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!"

Pick the single best promo.
